routines.title: Weekly ledger reconcile
routines.prompt: Reconcile last week's bank export for {{YOUR_COMPANY}}. Return matched rows, the needs-review queue, and one cash warning. Follow skills/bookkeeping-tax-prep/SKILL.md. Draft only.

routines.title: Month-end close pack
routines.prompt: Draft the month-end close checklist: accruals, prepaids, unmatched cash, and questions for the tax professional. Do not file anything. Follow skills/bookkeeping-tax-prep/SKILL.md. Draft only.

routines.title: Quarterly estimate reminder
routines.prompt: Prepare the quarterly estimate question list and remind {{YOUR_OWNER_NAME}} this is bookkeeping support, not a filed return. Follow skills/bookkeeping-tax-prep/SKILL.md. Draft only.
